Be the first player to bank enough cargo. In the Short Tide that means ten points. In the Full Tide it means twenty points.

Each turn you refill your hand and then launch a boat. Load cargo onto your boats, but never more than a boat can carry. Never launch more than one boat in a single turn. Sail a loaded boat out to bank its points. When your turn ends the tide rises.

A squall can beach a boat and spill its cargo. A buoyant boat shrugs off any squall.

Driftwood quick start, page one
